subtitles.en: Caodai séance messages of 1925–1926 — the Caodai pilot of the Translation Program

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of Thánh Ngôn Hiệp Tuyển, Quyển Nhứt (Compilation of Divine Messages, Volume One; Tòa Thánh Tây Ninh, 1928) from the Vietnamese. Dated, numbered séance messages from a self-identifying higher intelligence announcing the Third Universal Amnesty. Initial scope: the opening sequence of foundational messages from Noël 1925 through April 1926.
